questions.q: How is Cambridge IGCSE Art & Design 0400 assessed?
options: Two components, each worth 50%, marked from digital portfolios
A practical exam worth 75% plus a written paper worth 25%
questions.why: Component 1 (Coursework) and Component 2 (Externally Set Assignment) are each 100 marks and 50%, submitted as digital portfolios.

questions.q: How long is the supervised test in Component 2 in total?
questions.why: The final outcome is made in a supervised test of 8 hours' total duration.

questions.q: How many marks is each assessment objective worth in each component?
questions.why: AO1 to AO4 are each 25 marks, so 25% of each component.

questions.q: Explain why the final outcome alone cannot earn a top mark.
questions.model: The final outcome mainly shows AO4, which is only 25% of the marks. AO1, AO2 and AO3 are judged from the studies (recording, exploring and selecting, developing with critical understanding), so strong studies are needed too.
points: AO4 is only 25 of the 100 marks
AO1–AO3 are shown mainly through the studies
